reviews.title: Learning piano
reviews.text: Great app, starts with a basic things, like how to sit and place your hands properly, how to use play basic chords and begin to form a pattern to your playing. Love the app!

reviews.title: Intermediate - Exactly what I needed
reviews.text:
After 25 months years, I got my first blister on my finger :)  Amazing structure and approach. I have so much knowledge and the first pathways are bringing it all together. I can’t wait to dig into others. Perfect level of challenge, education, theory, and simple techniques. 

Developer:  add buffering into your video, I want to be able to move forward and backward without rebuffering. 
Add a +/- 15 seconds on the videos
Add chapters to navigate to a particular section

Make way to have the Tab be more prominent. I feel like I have to position it just right to see. I actually don’t need to see the I structure by default. Just occasionally. My $0.02.

reviews.title: Stabilization on iPad
reviews.text: Solid program but PLEASE look into stabilizing the iPad version. Several complaints such as: settings do not save, re- sizing issues, and absolute worst of all the app crashes about 9/10 times when you attempt to watch a video full screen. Then you have to manually close the app fully and repeat closure of the past 2-3 lessons because your progress didn’t save. Extremely frustrating so can you please look into this

reviews.title: Greatest guitar learning app
reviews.text: I’ve used JustinGuitar, GuitarTricks and WorshipArtistry, an PickupMusic is the best. The guided learning plans, and teacher feedback has helped me immensely. For the price of two guitar lessons with a live teacher I am receiving a year of lessons on guitar, bass, piano and soon drums. What a phenomenal learning experience.

reviews.title: Cannot say enough good things about pickup music.
reviews.text: If you want to learn your instrument, definitely use this app. It got me out of my guitar slump and accelerated my progress so fast. I love the format of the classes and that you can move at your own pace. Very high quality classes.

reviews.title: Great, would love more!
reviews.text:
I think it’s a fantastic interface, and the the core learning has been fantastic so far. Rock through the ages is cool too! 

I would love to see a classical and flamenco course!

reviews.title: Love it! Beginner pathway
reviews.text:
I am learning so much with this program. I been learning for 2 years but this is the first time I feel like everything is coming together. I’m excited to see how well I will be playing in the next couple
Months.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: This app is easy to navigate and constantly getting new content. The instructors, particularly Karl and Molly, are outstanding. I’ve learned a ton.

reviews.title: Love This App!
reviews.text: Corbin Jones is the best teacher you’ll find! This app is perfect for new and old players alike. I took a 12 year break from playing music live and needed something to get me back into shape. Not only did this app help brush off the dust, I actually feel like I’m better now than I was. Worth the money.

reviews.title: A bit too jazzy
reviews.text: Good lessons though

reviews.title: Love this app so much
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for a few years now. It was great when it first came out and it’s improved a ton since. Cannot recommend Pickup Music highly enough.

reviews.title: This is it!
reviews.text: I gave this app another try and it turns out the confusion I first experienced was all me. This is what I have been missing in my learning experience.

reviews.title: Really cool
reviews.text: It helps you feel like your building and growing instead of just learning bits and pieces of your favorite songs. I like it a lot actually. It is worth the money.

reviews.title: Really loving this all
reviews.text: I think this app is fantastic! I’ve been playing for over a decade and the coaches still all provide really great tips and feedback and the videos are super top quality. I’m loving it and that I’m learning new stuff in what feels like years!

reviews.title: Super helpful
reviews.text: Love pickup music. The subscription is a little pricey but compared to in person lessons it’s cheap and the results are undeniable. Leave your guitar out so you can grab it and do a quick jam and you’ll progress.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: If you want to learn. THIS IS THE APP- they better never lose this app. I love it so much

reviews.title: Self taught Guitar blessing
reviews.text: This app is the perfect solution to lost people teaching themselves how to play guitar online. This allows you to have direction within learning and cover all the little things you may have missed while self training yourself. This so so awesome!!

reviews.title: So worth
reviews.text: Very well structured lessons and well designed app. Couldnt ask for more

reviews.title: Best online program
reviews.text: I’ve tried many online programs, this is the only one that Keeps me having fun every single class. Love it and highly recommended it!

reviews.title: Easy
reviews.text: I love it so far, very easy to understand and learn! Beginner Bass player

reviews.title: App can be better, but courses are great
reviews.text: I have improved my skills since signing up. It motivates me to practice more and more importantly, gives me songs and techniques to work on. The app can be better though. Especially exercise page. I don’t like how they organize the exercise page, where I often tab the wrong place and jump to different places of the video. In addition, once I hide the video to check on the sheet music, I can never get the video back, unless closing and relaunching the exercise page.

reviews.title: Very approachable
reviews.text: I love how this app splits up lessons, it’s very approachable. I’m picking up guitar again after a long time away and going back through the beginner course has been really fulfilling. My only gripe so far is that the tabs sometimes don’t scroll into view quite fast enough.

reviews.title: Great tool, great service
reviews.text: Pickup Music has become a major part of my musical journey these past two years.  But having the best guitar instruction on the internet wasn’t enough for them.  They keep pushing and now have this app.  And since launch they have been on top of their support getting this app to the place it needs to be.  Well done guys!

reviews.title: Love the App
reviews.text: But…. There are some bugs, videos cut out and quit etc..

reviews.title: pickup music is a 10/10
reviews.text: If you can play bar chords and improvise the pentatonic scale then this app will change your life. the reviews speak for themselves, you will learn tremendously and have a ton of fun while doing it. I’m excited each day to do a module which has a lesson and exercises and ends with an opportunity to apply some improvising during a jam session.

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text: Great app. Though if I'm on my iPad the videos won't play for some reason.

reviews.title: Addictive!
reviews.text:
I love this app. I was trying to learn guitar with YouTube but got nowhere. I downloaded this app 2 months ago and since then I’ve been playing every single day and I am really seeing a lot of progress. I uploaded my first video and the feedback was very helpful. 
As an extra I could say I would love to have the option of having some private lessons, like another section where you can pay an extra fee and get a lesson with the same teachers who give you feedback. 
Btw, the fact you can win a guitar every month is exciting.

reviews.title: Versatile and fun
reviews.text: Really loving this service, especially since they added bass to their set of courses. One feature that wish they had was a “review tab” where they randomly selected a “jam session” from the end of each lesson you’ve already completed. Kind of a like a pop quiz. I like to start each practice by reviewing the “jam session” from the previous day.  But the navigation tools inside the app make it tedious to navigate to lessons from past weeks. And randomly selecting lesson would make reviewing feel more fresh.

reviews.title: Best guitar app out there
reviews.text: I am learning so much from using this app and I’m so grateful that I signed up. I’m a professional musician and I teach guitar and this app really has so many great tools in it to deep in my own practice and learn about how to teach more effectively. They make it so easy to excel and improve. It’s organized and all the resources are so useful. Well done!

reviews.title: I love this program
reviews.text: Each lesson is just the right amount of practice and difficulty level, I’m bad at practicing but I find that I look forward to this everyday

reviews.title: Phenomenal experience
reviews.text: This is honestly one of the best learning experiences (not just guitar) I’ve had for gaining any new skill. It is extremely well structured and you actually begin to understand how this instrument works, not just memorize a few licks or a single pentatonic scale. It’s also fun and I look forward to practicing! Well worth the price!! Karl Kerfoot is a fantastic teacher.

reviews.title: Busy Work
reviews.text:
I’ve used pickup music for a couple of months now and it has some decent content but it’s all jam packed with stuff to keep you busy instead of actually teaching you how to play. 

Molly the CAGED instructor is insufferable she’ll do all these crazy riffs and licks but not explain anything so you’re sitting there like why don’t I sound like that. Wouldn’t doubt if most beginners shy away for this alone. 

I’ve learned quite a bit but not how to apply it which is like most YouTube tutorials. If you are willing to shovel 179 dollars a year for this you are essentially paying for YouTube content with a pathway that leads to the same end goal. Knowing but not knowing how to apply. 

When I first opened this app I was ready to give it all the money I had but now I’ll probably be looking elsewhere :(

reviews.title: Fantastic learning tool
reviews.text: I believe having this app on while holding a Guitar or Bass is a great way to learn and practice music.

reviews.title: Annoyingly good
reviews.text:
I have picked up the guitar probably 12 times in my life, and never made any real progress. Pickup is so well structured and executed, that I was entertained enough to get through the boring foundational stuff, and now feel like I actually understand how the fretboard works. The lessons are digestible enough to do with 15-30 min per day, and they build very logically. All of the backing tracks and the jams really do bring even basic stuff like CAGED to life. 

The app itself is built with care, and mostly functions great, but does have some shortcomings. Sometimes it’s hard to know where you are in the lesson structure, and it takes a few seconds of tapping around to find your spot.

Overall, I’ve been using it for almost 2 months, and feel like it’s more than worth the money. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: The Best Structured Guitar Lessons Out There!
reviews.text: I’m completely new to guitar and I didn’t know where to begin. This app was perfect giving consistent instructional videos on how to properly play guitar!

reviews.title: A11Y/UX/usability needs improvement with VoiceOver:
reviews.text:
Hi. I have asked a few times internally and have just been told Accessibility improvements are coming. Still have seen zero improvements. I am a paying member and can barely use this iOS app and Web app. Biggest pain points are bad accessible names, lack of element semantics, bad container grouping, focus management, announcements.
 
When I open one of the course cards with VoiceOver on, I cannot interact with the entire next page. The video auto plays and I have zero control with voiceover.

I cannot interact with the entire explore page from the bottom tab as voiceover reads it as one giant image container.

These are all fast easy fixes. Please just devote a sprint or two to make this usable for VoiceOver users.

reviews.title: Great Program, App needs adjustment
reviews.text:
Hi - great program and love that you made an app available.

Feedback: I am unable to put the exercise videos in landscape mode on my mobile device, so it is difficult to practice and watch the videos on the go. iPhone most recent  iOS - thanks!

reviews.title: Great For Beginners, Dusting Off The Cobwebs, Or Those Who Simply Want To Get Better
reviews.text:
This app is fantastic! I took lessons over twenty years ago and got to the point where I was comfortable and stopped. I’ve been messing around on the acoustic guitar ever since, but really just playing the same songs over and over (Blackbird being a favorite).

Recently, I decided to get back into my guitar playing and wanted to find something with lessons that truly broke things down and allowed me to truly learn, understand, and progress. This app fits the bill perfectly. 

I tried a few other “gamified” apps, and while I had some fun, I wasn’t making progress in a way that allowed me to truly understand what to I was doing right, what I was doing wrong, and the theory behind the techniques and music.

I started with some of the beginner lessons to “brush up” and while they were overly simplistic for my current level of play, it was a good exercise to skim through them. I even picked up a fee techniques that I either never learned, or had forgotten. So worth it.

I feel like I am taking lessons with a live instructor, and it’s as close to that as you can get in an app. Great job to the developers. Looking forward to this journey!

reviews.title: Helpful but could use some fixes
reviews.text: So far I’ve been enjoying it. The ability to double tap on the sides during videos to rewind or go forward by 10 seconds would be immensely helpful. I try to replay a part to see how something was done and end up moving the slider back and forth trying to find the right spot.

reviews.title: Excellent Tool
reviews.text: I’m incredibly grateful to have stumbled upon this platform. Since joining, I’ve genuinely enjoyed the learning process, diligently completing the daily lessons and witnessing my progress unfold. It’s become an invaluable resource as I’ve taken my musical journey to new heights, both solo and with peers. I highly recommend this platform to anyone seeking a reliable, practical, and innovative learning tool that’s user-friendly and affordable.

reviews.title: Excellent lessons!
reviews.text: Learning a lot

reviews.title: Great platform, excited for app upgrades
reviews.text: Love the platform! The bite sized lessons and exercises are perfect for steady and consistent progress. I’m an intermediate level and felt like I was stuck, but this helped me get out of that rut. The app has made it even easier to pick up and start a lesson whenever I have time, which is super important for my style of learning. I really hope to see landscape support soon, that would be my biggest request. Some other video controls could be helpful too, like skipping back a few seconds. Thanks to the team!

reviews.title: Love the app and its community
reviews.text: I love the app. The lessons and the community really makes the journey of learning to play more enjoyable. It’s not gamified and I retain what I’ve learnt without depending on the app.

reviews.title: By far the best
reviews.text: I’ve tried maby many courses online and while they all have pieces they excel at, none are as comprehensive, community focused as Pickup Music is. I’ve been with them now over 2 years and don’t plan on stopping anytime soon as they continue to add new content every month. Great work Sam, Karl, and team!

reviews.title: Enjoying so far
reviews.text: Just started, and really enjoying the app. It *really* needs an iPad version, or the ability to go fullscreen on the ipad though.

reviews.title: Best app to learn guitar
reviews.text: I’ve tried a bunch of free and paid programs by big-name companies, and Pickup is the only one that has actually helped me blast through playing plateaus. In the year and a half I’ve been using it, I’ve looked forward to every single day.

reviews.title: Best app for guitarists

reviews.title: Great way to learn guitar

reviews.text: Only 3  stars till landscape mode appears.
